title: thebasics:thebasics-handbook-title-scene-markers
text: Scene markers hold persistent roleplay descriptions without filling a build with large written signs. Craft one from any two loose stones, then place the small marker flat on the ground or against a wall. Writing and reading - Hold Shift and right-click a placed marker to edit its title, body, and display mode. - Choose When targeted, Always nearby, or On interaction for floating descriptions. Always nearby has its own text distance and Unlimited setting. - Plain right-click opens the complete description in every mode. The top-middle inspector shows a short preview. The floating symbol invites nearby players to inspect it. - Break a marker to pick it up with its title, description, presentation, and author metadata intact. Hold Shift and right-click the item to read it. Editing follows normal land-claim permissions. Scene markers are durable world content, separate from temporary /envhere and !! cast messages and separate from local or global OOC chat settings. Locking The creator can choose Save & lock in the editor. No padlock item is needed. Locked markers remain readable and open read-only. Only the creator or a server admin with claim access can unlock them in the editor or pick them up. Locks and creator identity survive pickup and replacement. Appearance Use the symbol tiles and preview to choose an exclamation, question, information, solid dot, hollow ring, or diamond billboard. Select Plain or Hologram independently of the symbol. Hologram adds translucent scan lines and a gentle shimmer to the indicator. Idle bobbing can be toggled in the editor. The camera-facing symbol grows slightly when targeted; the floating text bubble stays still. Choose warm gold, parchment, muted blue or soft green, and adjust its height from -0.5 to 4 blocks. Indicator size is independently adjustable from 25 to 300 percent, with 100 percent as the original size. Description text keeps its own size. The live preview shows your symbol and bubble together. Show description in bubble is off by default: the bubble shows its title and a right-click reading cue. Turn it on to include the description. Right-click always opens the full text. Billboard distance accepts 1-1024 blocks (default 24). Unlimited removes the distance fade but still requires loaded terrain. Walls obscure the billboard. Nearby text defaults to 8 blocks and can fade independently from the icon. Fresh markers remember your last saved appearance on this server with empty text. Picked-up markers retain their own settings. Appearance settings survive pickup and replacement, and locked markers must be unlocked before changing them.
